title.en: The relational self and 大同

summary.en: The folder holds a self as what a knot of relations is doing, a false split of individual and collective, and 大同 as a direction reachable by mechanism. The self's form stands in 07 §1 and §4, 03 and 08, as a thesis, conditional and with the crux open. Agreement with the form of a law is narrow: that relation does not generate ethics, and what closes a loop. 大同, 五常 and the 人类命运共同体 formalism are absent, and what links to 大同 is mostly proposed here. Divergence was looked for and is prominent: no law evaluates, relation gives no cooperation, and the folder's wider self is P4, not shown.

name.en: The I as an action-centre of gathered relations

source.locator: The theory in one paragraph; claim 1

sense.en: A self is no bounded thing that later enters relationships: it is what a knot of relations does at a place, formed by body and nature, care, language, others' recognition, institutions and history, and its own choices and corrections. Stated as observation of causal order, from a book drafted from Ren's ideas.

entries.quote: 「我」非关系之外之原点，乃诸关系暂聚而成之行动中心

reading.en: Agreement with a thesis and readings, not with a law: same form as explanation: a center is a formation and its own region a closure along some relation, so 'self' is relative to a relation drawn within the unfolding; taker and drawn-on, knower and known differentiate within relations, as far as shown. The folder tags its claim [observation]; the account's thesis excludes no observation and is argued, not proved, with two defeaters named. Center is wider than the source's agent: any formation is one. The account lists nothing that constitutes a person. [AI reading]

says.en: On the thesis of one relational unfolding, argued and not proved, positions, regions and standards form within it. A center is a formation; its own region is its closure under some relation.

Thesis, argued: forbids an explanation needing a determination no relation carries, such as a self with a nature of its own. By its own measure it has no strength: it excludes no observation. Live defeaters: that relations need relata with natures of their own, and that what an experience is like is not how it relates. That the theory needs no independent entity is argued, and neither shows reality has none.

targets.part: what the thesis forbids; its defeaters

says.en: Reading [AI reading]: along a relation a formation's boundary is given by a region holding it and closed under the relation; which boundaries it has depends on the relation followed. Not shown: a graded boundary, and how a formation forms or represents its boundary.

targets.part: the reading of a boundary along a relation

says.en: A formation that senses, predicts, chooses, acts and revises is one law within the unfolding, not a subject facing a world: its internal part reads what goes on through what it senses, and what it does is part of what goes on.

Theorem (World): formations and conditions are two roles of one relatum. What the one-kind reading adds, that condition x and formation x are one relatum, the shared index supplies and the laws do not check. In a balanced flow in which only active formations give, an embodied relatum arises only as another active formation gives to it; embodied is a premise about particular relata, not a definition of life.
One unfolding is a thesis, argued: within relations, as far as shown, taker and drawn-on are two roles of one relatum and knower and known one loop, and responsibility is not shown to differentiate.

Reading [AI reading, new]: under an organism's class nothing of the self follows its end, under a coarser one the line can go on through new members. What the represented dynamics leave open, held de se, is which class a center's own line runs under.

account_adds.en: Which relation or class is a center's own stays open; a privileged narrower relation is costly, not refuted (07 §4.2). §4.7 draws the self three ways: this organism, what one intends, everything one conditions. How a formation forms or represents its boundary is not shown, and responsibility is not shown to differentiate.

source_adds.en: The inventory of what forms a person (care, language, recognition, institutions) and the self's own choices and corrections as part of the knot.

name.en: Relational constitution increases autonomy

sense.en: Seeing how one was formed lets one tell which desires come from life and which were installed, and which beliefs one examined. So relation raises autonomy rather than lowering it: an isolated self has only wilfulness, a self in relations can be free.

entries.quote: 孤立之我只有任性，关系中之我方有自由

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text joins them. The telling-apart has a form, in witnesses of two worlds: across two starts, the answers and the final state do not determine whether a valuation changed, while the record with the start does. Read so, that is which desires were installed, as a law about records. The account stops there: no criterion of legitimate, desired or autonomous change is supplied, seeing is not valuing, and later endorsement cannot authorize the formation that produced it. Nothing says that seeing one's formation raises freedom. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem, compositions none claimed new as mathematics: from different starts, the route shown and the route presented answer alike at every step and end in one state while the valuation changed on the second alone, so whether it changed is not lumped through the answers and the final state, though with the start added it is. Reading [AI reading, new]: no criterion of legitimate, desired or autonomous change is supplied; a case of one start is not reached.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: later endorsement cannot authorize the formation that produced it; learning a disposition is not learning a reason.
Seeing is not valuing: enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate, not which differences matter.

account_adds.en: What a reader of the answers alone leaves open: how the state that answered came to be.

source_adds.en: That relation raises autonomy rather than lowering it, freedom against wilfulness, and desires from life against installed ones. No live sentence speaks of them.

name.en: Self-care and other-care as one instruction

sense.en: Caring for oneself and for one's environment was one common sense; individualism against collectivism is the wreckage of it, and both halves split are pathological. The inner logic of relational thinking: the better the world, the better I am (a translated spoken line, own words 70). Stated flatly, Ren's own.

entries.quote: 这个世界越好，我也就越好

reading.en: The account gives where the unconditional form holds. 'The better the world, the better I am' has an exact form: an order rising with one's own continuation and one rising with all admission coincide exactly where one's continuation marks everything, a near-definitional join. Route (b) reaches the self and what it depends on, the whole only where it is one feeding closure. The condition (scope) and C (order) stay unasserted, warrant open; whether a net meets this is empirical. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; World instances). Route (b) and the condition are one presupposition, 'however the boundary is drawn' at narrow and at wide scope; along the empty relation sub-truth is a standpoint's own good, along the total relation the condition. The record's reading of Ren's words on 'we' and 'no absolute self' is by descent; the theorem stands apart from it.
Theorem (any type; World). Held de se, self-concern is the same from every standpoint exactly where every center lies within every center's closure; the whole need not lie within it.

Theorem (any type; root; Web). On a listing, every order is self-concerned exactly when it is increasing in admission if and only if the marking marks every listed item. This locates where the two coincide, proves no property of reach and does not derive C; self-concern and the condition remain hypotheses.

Theorem (World) and Conditional (the condition). With each formation's significance stopping at its dependence, the clearer's part retains everything for the clearer and loses the dweller for the dweller.
Thesis: a collective is a region of formed relations, not a unit with an interest of its own; conflict and difference stay real.

Reading [AI reading, D17]: with no condition, 'should' is what a center does once its represented boundary matches what it depends on; since a loss returns to a center through its feeders, this gives, without warranting, a reason of its own to retain what lies within its closure. It reaches the self and what it depends on, the whole only where it is one feeding closure.

Theorem (any type; World). Self-concern is a premise weaker than C's: every order increasing in admission is increasing in its own continuation, and the two coincide where that continuation is everything listed. Where the other course keeps an independent copy, some such order reverses (`Weighting.some_increasingInOwn_reverses`).

account_adds.en: A self-concerned order can reverse where the other course keeps an independent copy (`Weighting.some_increasingInOwn_reverses`); the two come apart in named cases.

source_adds.en: That self-care and other-care are one instruction, unconditionally. Also the historical claim of an original common sense and its wreckage; 'collectivism' as an outside oversimplification; and both halves as pathological, where the account evaluates neither and reads a position as no defect.

name.en: Distinct and constituted, held at once

source.locator: The argument, 'The mirror error'; The theory in one paragraph

sense.en: Collectivism without agency produces conformity, suppression and the erasure of the person. The move is to deny the axis: one must hold 'I am a distinct agent with my own perspective and rights' and 'I am constituted by and responsible to a web of relationships' at once. The ontology is what makes both holdable. Ren's own, as 阴阳 and a middle way.

entries.quote: predates the individualism-collectivism split entirely

reading.en: Same structure, as thesis, method and reading, not as a law. A boundary short of the whole is real and relative to its relation, so distinct and constituted do not compete; nonduality erases no difference; a collective is no unit with an interest of its own. The erasure has a form only for codes: an imposed code makes all agree and each loses the distinctions it merges, which speaks of forms and not of persons. These are laws and readings of regions and codes, evaluating nothing. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45, D61]: a boundary short of the whole is real, since its relation never crosses it, and relative to that relation; which boundaries a formation has depends on the relation followed.

Nonduality erases no difference in experience, history, access, control, consent or consequence. A shared process implies no cosmic subject, no aggregate interest and no administrator entitled to speak for everything.
Thesis: a collective is a region of formed relations, not a unit with an interest of its own; conflict and difference stay real.
Theorem (any type). An imposed code makes all agree; each formation loses exactly the distinctions its code drew that the imposed code merges.
Among what the argument does not show: any duty, right, recognition, motivation or compliance.
A description of participation confers no authority, permission or right.

account_adds.en: That both are held by drawing boundaries along stated relations, not by balance.

source_adds.en: Rights, which the account lists as not shown, and that the middle way was and should be common sense.

name.en: Therapeutic individualism: others dropped from the frame

sense.en: Therapeutic individualism is past selfishness: it does not weigh others and choose itself, it has lost them from the frame, so a wound produced by relational rupture is treated as repairable by inner work. A diagnosis of a culture.

entries.quote: A wound produced by relational rupture is treated as repairable by internal work alone.

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text joins them. The distinction has a form, and the diagnosis does not. Weighing others and choosing oneself, against losing them from the frame, is the account's informed harm against an omission of the representation, kept apart in a reading; the laws of selection state the second: what lies beyond does not couple in. Both speak of any formation, with no culture, therapy or wound, and 07 names informed harm the hard rival. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65]. Kept apart: an omission of the representation, a fault in organized relations (suppressed feedback, blocked exit) and informed harm (a harmful arrangement kept knowingly, no loss returning), the hard rival, which tests the inference from one unfolding to goodwill without refuting normative grounds.

Theorem (World; no premise): two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's couplings exactly when they are alike through them. Thesis of the chapter: a selector's couplings bound what any selection through them can depend on; what lies beyond does not couple in.

source_adds.en: The cultural diagnosis itself: therapy, the wound, and that this is further gone than selfishness. It stands only here and in its sources in 12-claude-ai-chats.

name.en: Relation-aware faculties disciplined; atomisation as domestication

sense.en: Innate relation-aware faculties are incompatible with the larger system as built, so they get disciplined rather than integrated, producing misalignment suffering; atomisation is an effective domestication strategy that harms both self and network. Ren's own, tagged mechanism, 2026-04-12.

entries.quote: atomization, it's a good domestication strategy, but it hurts the self and harms the network

reading.en: A claim about human faculties and their suffering, with no term in the account, which has no interior of a person. 04's reading of development asks of any disposition what mechanism produces it now and says a present benefit does not establish origin. 'Innate' would meet 06's layer of a preset nature. The laws of selection and draw say nothing of what a faculty was. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The whole claim. It stands in the folder and its source in 12-claude-ai-chats, 2026-04-12.

name.en: Individual solutions to a collective problem

sense.en: Offering individual solutions to a collective problem reproduces the disease diagnosed, a standing correction Ren applies to his own drafts. In the 2026-10-04 monologue: one may seek peace and love, but structural problems must be solved first; one cannot simply drop out. A value stance.

entries.quote: Offering individual solutions to a collective problem reproduces the disease being diagnosed

reading.en: The account gives where it holds, under hypotheses: where the others alone outrun a renewal, a member's act changes no score reading the condition from then on; each staying within a step's giving does not keep the joint take within it. Urgency has only a window's form: before the regime's point of no return. The laws bear on kinds of case, evaluate nothing and date nothing, and a restraint within the joint slack can keep a need. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World: balance, activity needing support, only active giving). Where the rest jointly take more than a step gives across n steps from below n + m, dependents end whatever a member outside the rest takes; no weight on such a reading selects the member's restraint. Depletion need not be the only equilibrium.
Theorem (World: balance). Formations can each take within what a step gives while together they take more.

Reading [AI reading, D45]. Time: it happens before the regime's point of no return. Structure: where the rest outruns the renewal, no weight on a score reading the condition only from the rest's end selects restraint, and only a change of the rest's exchange helps. All six conditions together still rank nothing.

account_adds.en: Named collective exits, each under hypotheses, none shown of an actual collective: pooling couplings, restraint within joint slack, exclusive footprints, reading the loss in time.

source_adds.en: That the individual framing itself reproduces the disease, urgency stated of the present, and structural problems to be solved first.

name.en: Interconnectedness, not compassion, requires cooperation

source.locator: Claim 6; The argument, 'Why does cooperation follow?'

sense.en: Cooperation must follow from structure, not feeling: outcomes are coupled, some problems are soluble only by the whole, and rivalry cannot cure what it creates. Compassion is an evolved module, a good North Star, unreliable in practice: it narrows to the tribe, serves violence, is operable by power.

entries.quote: So compassion is the bearing; interconnectedness is the argument.

reading.en: The structure is there: joint excess, and differences parts make only together, a law of breaking a dependence and not of solving a problem. 'Requires cooperation' is not: mutual dependence is not mutual benefit, and among optimizers restraint is no mutual best response. A structural reason for cooperating needs an order, so C or a premise in its place, with the condition for scope, neither asserted, warrant open. Sympathy's blindness has readings in 06: 见牛未见羊, and a 感应 exact within the closure and blind beyond it. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World). Mutual dependence: every continuation can be affected, at some remove, by every other. The section: mutual dependence is not mutual benefit.

Theorem (any process). Parts make a difference together while no member alone does exactly where they make it together and withholding any one leaves the move breaking the dependence; such a difference needs at least two parts.
Law (World; a mutual best response, its existence not shown in general): each takes its whole capacity wherever something stands beyond, so restraint is no mutual best response.
Reading [AI reading]: 见牛未见羊, selection is blind beyond couplings, one's own act included.
Reading [AI reading]: even skilled control may be 不仁: selection reaches only what couples in, and 感应, however exact within the closure, stays blind beyond it.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: care has several entries, to be tested side by side; a model that puts the target directly in a reward or “天然善” has not yet explained it.

account_adds.en: Which orders select restraint and which do not, and that an evolutionary explanation of a disposition is not its warrant, recognition or following (04, Development).

source_adds.en: That the structure itself requires cooperation, which the account denies. Also compassion as a bearing with its catalogue of failures; 06 only says care has several entries to be tested side by side.

name.en: Relation does not generate ethics: the parasite

sense.en: Interdependence is a lens, not a foundation. It makes ethical commitment legible and shows why atomistic frameworks fail, but it does not generate ethics; what we owe each other is chosen. An AI review's correction the corpus adopted, leaving one owned is-to-ought step.

entries.quote: a parasite is related to its host

reading.en: The same limit, by construction of the representation: no statement reading only the dynamics entails the continuation condition, none reading no order entails C. The source's parasite has a form: mutual dependence is not mutual benefit, and Clearing keeps a supported clearer with an unsupported dweller. Where the folder leaves one owned is-to-ought step, the account holds two premises, the condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted, warrant open. Non-entailment by the represented dynamics, not a proof about becoming. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World, no premise for the closures). Mutual dependence: every continuation can be affected, at some remove, by every other. The section's opening: mutual dependence is not mutual benefit.

Theorem (any type). Where there is a standpoint and a formation, a statement reading only the dynamics that entails the condition holds of no dynamics. It shows non-entailment by the represented dynamics, not that becoming leaves significance undetermined.
Two premises, neither asserted: the condition fixes whose losses count and ranks nothing; C gives order. A statement reading no order entails C only where it fails (`ReadsNoOrder.not_entails`).
Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum divided among independent owners. It does not remove rivalry, and both are theorems.

account_adds.en: The folder asks which downstream claims survive the demotion; the account gives laws with no premise, then what each premise adds. P1 reads part of scope as what acting presupposes, with warrant still open.

source_adds.en: That the relational fact makes commitment legible and shows why atomistic frameworks fail at coordination, care and the commons; and that what we owe is chosen. The account removes one frame and does not call the premises chosen.

name.en: Maintaining the self is a step to the whole

sense.en: Two evolutionary axes, maintaining the self and orienting to everything beyond. Satisfying the first steps into the second: every recognised self is the whole recognising that self; the environment is created by every self in it, so in a way they are also the self. Ren's own, 2026-04-19.

entries.quote: the environment is also created by every self within it, therefore, in a way, they are also the self

reading.en: The source's 'therefore' is P4 of the future path, that everything one conditions is alike to oneself, which the account says is not shown, with objections standing: wrong bearer, losses are not effects, the poison with the river. Route (b) alone reaches what one depends on, and the extent it derives runs one way and ends with the want. The step of invariance is argued and coherently denied. The condition (scope) and C (order) stay unasserted, warrant open. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; World). Held de se, self-concern is the same from every standpoint exactly where every center lies within every center's closure; the whole need not lie within it. It still does not reach what lies beyond every center's closure.

Argued, not proved: (P2) what is one's own is a region drawn along a relation and no law of the dynamics fixes which; (P4) what acting presupposes is not continuation under a description of its own drawing. A relation the facts privilege denies P2; P4 is coherently denied.

Under P1 to P4, one's concern for one's own continuation reaches everything downstream of what one conditions, with no step of invariance (a law, given the premises). Not reached: what no chain joins, and each center counting from another's standpoint beyond its part as a condition. P2 and P4 are the crux.

AI reading, argued, not proved: none of the candidates is ruled out, and P4 is not shown. Objections stand: wrong bearer; losses are not effects; a class holding all one's effects holds what one ruins as well (the poison with the river), a reason to doubt that 'one's own' is the right word. It concerns whose losses count, not what one answers for.
Classified by AI as a divergence of standing: 程颢's 仁者以天地万物为一体 and 阳明's 本然良知 state as a recognized fact what the theory holds as an unasserted condition plus the step of invariance.
The extent derived from wanting one's own continuation runs one way, to what it depends on, and ends with the want; the clearer meets every requirement so derived and still ends the dweller.

Reading [AI reading, D54]: 《维摩诘所说经》 is a comparison: care need not first take the other as one's own part, nor can it be inferred only from one shared substance; bodhisattva practice and great compassion are premises there, which the theory does not assert.

account_adds.en: Exactly where 'maintaining the self is a step to the whole' holds along dependence, and what the path leaves to the step.

source_adds.en: The 'therefore' itself, that the environment each self helps create is that self: stated only as P4, which is not shown. Also two axes as evolved drives, and satisfying the self (not in survival mode, not hijacked) as a precondition for coherence with the whole.

name.en: 'Beyond the drive, there is no self'

source.locator: Claim 8; own words 40; critiques, 'Beyond the drive'; open questions, 'No self as the fit of a model'

sense.en: Stated once and never developed: a drive maintains existence at the self level, but beyond the drive there is no self. The folder calls it either deflationary (no substance beyond a maintenance circuit) or mystical (the self dissolves into the whole), theories with different consequences for the ethics; the 2026-10-04 talk supplies an epistemic reading. Own words 40 are marked the fullest statement of the relational self.

entries.quote: beyond the drive, there is no self

reading.en: The deflationary half has a home: the thesis forbids an explanation needing a self with a nature of its own, and no law of the dynamics fixes which region is one's own. But the account does not end the self at a drive: the organism is one row of §4.7's three selves, none ruled out. It declines the mystical half: a shared process implies no cosmic subject. That no independent entity is needed is argued, and does not show reality has none. [AI reading]

says.en: Thesis, argued: forbids an explanation needing a determination no relation carries, such as a self with a nature of its own. That the theory as a whole needs no independent entity is argued, not proved; neither shows that reality has none.

Argued, not proved: (P2) what is 'one's own' is a region drawn along a relation of the unfolding, and no law of the dynamics fixes which. A relation the facts privilege (the organism's life) denies it.
AI reading: three selves, this organism, what one intends, everything one conditions; none is ruled out, and P4 is not shown.
A shared process implies no cosmic subject, no aggregate interest and no administrator entitled to speak for everything.

account_adds.en: The bearing the folder asks for: a wider or narrower self concerns whose losses count, and scope ranks nothing.

source_adds.en: The drive as the limit of the self, and 'every recognised self is the whole recognising that self'. The folder leaves the reading undecided; its epistemic reading is under 逍遥.

name.en: Good as what is good for self and network

sense.en: Good is what is good for both the self and the network it is in; better is the direction of increasing both; where they conflict, use wisdom, never either/or, never disregarding the future. Later: 'a future that has broader possibility space' (own words 38). Stated as Ren's value criterion.

entries.quote: use wisdom, never either or, never disregarding the future

reading.en: The source calls it good; the account gives the comparison with no premise and calls it better only under C, the condition fixing scope, neither asserted, warrant open. 'Broader possibility space' sits near C's widening, as a stated good where the account has an unasserted premise. The form matches: a part's own widening widens the whole exactly within others' margins, and otherwise is mixed. What the source gives to wisdom the account leaves to further named premises, J1 to J4. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; balance). Where a part's activity widens what can form within its own region, the whole widens exactly when its net draw stays within the margin for every formation outside the region; mixed exactly when beyond for one. Mixed is not ordered.

Theorem (finite listing, two-valued admission, natural weights). One course widens another exactly when every positive weighting ranks it higher; a mixed comparison is decided both ways. Calling it better is C.
Choices take more, following from neither the condition nor C: a reading of living, the lifting L and the commitments J1 to J4.
The direction is a criterion on which every positive weighting agrees, not a quantity to maximize, and it says nothing where the comparison is mixed.

account_adds.en: An exact local test, and the refusal to rank where a part's gain costs another.

source_adds.en: An unconditional definition of good, and wisdom as the arbiter at conflicts.

name.en: Boundaries and ego as territorial instinct

sense.en: The Western concept of boundaries is territorial instinct in connotation-neutral words, extending past space into social interaction and possession; ego is the same drive generalised from what is mine to what reality should be. Offered tentatively as a psychology ('Not sure if this is how the brain evolved').

entries.quote: instead of where and what is mine, it becomes this what reality should

reading.en: Same word, no same reference: the account's boundary is a region drawn along a relation, in one sense for anything, with no instinct and no ego. The folder also rejects 'boundaries' as Western framing (own words 38), a word the account keeps. Possession is only unrepresented on the spine, and no condition is silently taken as owned. 04 asks of any disposition what mechanism produces it, which this conjecture has not met. The folder lists it as lost from later drafts. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: Stands only here and in `drives-narrative-attractors-and-mind`, by the folder's own Relations.

name.en: 大同 as direction, not destination

sense.en: 礼运's verb is walking, so 大同 names a bearing, not a place; a pole star used to find direction and never reached. The question is never when we arrive but whether today's act moves toward or away. A direction cannot be achieved and defended, so it cannot become a totalising attractor. The 古文 essay is AI-composed to Ren's one-line prompt.

entries.quote: 今日所行，向之乎？背之乎？

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text joins them. The form direction-not-state recurs, and no identity follows: the account's direction is 生生 compared by widening, under the condition (scope) and C (order), both unasserted, warrant open; 大同's social content is not its content. 'Toward or away' is answered only at widenings; hard cases are mixed. Eventual widening is neither verifiable nor refutable. The word is absent from the live account; history/CHINESE-SOURCES-AND-BECOMING.md, not live, reads 小康 as dependence-bounded and 大同 as whole-bounded significance, the passage needing the step of invariance. [AI reading]

says.en: The direction is a criterion on which every positive weighting agrees, not a quantity to maximize, and it says nothing where the comparison is mixed. Available 'as a criterion only'.

Thesis T8, argued, no verdict binding every possible mind: for life, the way is 生生, compared by widening, counted for everything (scope: the condition) and ranked by what every valuer who counts everything shares (order: C).

Theorem (any process; witnesses), as stated at COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION §7: where every step from some step on is a move of a process Q, the possible under Q does not keep widening. Read [AI reading] openness is of how rules keep changing, not a rule chosen once.
Eventual widening is neither verifiable nor refutable (`Web.eventually_neither`).
Reading [AI reading, D45]: openness is a property of how rules keep changing, not of any rule chosen once, and not as a final state.

account_adds.en: Where no widening move exists: past a point of no return, after a window closes, where the rest outruns the renewal.

source_adds.en: 大同's own content, the word being absent from the live account; the grammatical argument from 行, and the pole star as practical orientation; and that a direction therefore cannot totalise. The account does not state that last: a rule read from its share locks whatever it favours.

name.en: 大同 as a maintained attractor basin

sense.en: 大同 is a continuously maintained dynamic condition, a generative attractor basin, in English a civilisation's capacity to return to the Great Way after drift; a society can drift out and return. Not a historical endpoint. From the AI-drafted book.

entries.quote: a civilisation's *capacity to return to the Great Way after drift*

reading.en: The account has basins and returning, with no good one among them: a configuration is drawn into some absorbing region exactly where it does not return, near-definitionally, and keeping every possibility no longer gives returning where the course branches. Stability and a frozen rule are one structure read from two sides. A basin of one fixed law cannot keep the possible under it widening. 'Capacity to return' is nearest a capacity to correct, one condition among others. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). Under any determined law, courses meeting is an equivalence whose classes are basins; a course reaches every returning configuration of its basin.

Reading [AI reading, D49]: 稳与元闭 are one structure on the spine, read from the side the rule holds as stability and from the side of a change as a frozen source; judgment enters only through comparison, never through a definition.

Theorem (any process): where every step from some step on is a move of Q, the possible under Q does not keep widening; keeping it widening needs the held part to change without end, which does not suffice.
A configuration is drawn into some absorbing region exactly where it does not return; near-definitional, not a classical attractor.
Where the course branches, keeping every possibility no longer gives returning.
Table [AI reading, D48], Keeping the capacity to correct: a difference closes only through a formation coupling the courses apart and exchanging differently.

account_adds.en: Exact laws of return, and that keeping a course open is not more options. Calling any basin better needs C, with the condition for scope, neither asserted, warrant open.

source_adds.en: A named good basin and capacity to return as what 大同 is.

name.en: 大同 is not uniformity: 和 not 同

sense.en: Harmony is difference in a relation where parts check and complete each other; sameness ends generation. Formally in the SSBX layer: 大同 affirms universal middle and is neutral on uniformity, winner-take-all requires uniformity, so reading 大同 as 整齐划一 is refutable. Content: 万物并育而不相害, a thousand paths in parallel.

entries.quote: 和实生物，同则不继

reading.en: Narrower than the source. 06 reads 和而不同 as what a pool adds: exactly the difference, and pooling the same adds nothing. Nearby, and joined by no live text: an imposed code makes all agree and each loses the distinctions it merges; 并育不相害 has the form of a part's draw within others' margins, and calling that better needs C, with the condition for scope, neither asserted, warrant open. No law gives sameness ending generation. 和而不同 itself is an evaluation of conduct. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World). A group's closure is the union of its members'; with members listed and coupling decided, a pooled selection separates two histories exactly when some member does not couple them alike.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: 和而不同, with members listed and couplings decided, what a pool adds is exactly the difference; pooling the same adds nothing.
Theorem (any type). An imposed code makes all agree; each formation loses exactly the distinctions its code drew that the imposed code merges, the source of the imposed code losing none.

Theorem (World; balance). Where a part's activity widens what can form within its own region, the whole widens exactly when its net draw stays within the margin for every formation outside the region, and is mixed exactly when it goes beyond for one.

Reading [AI reading, D54]: contention and rank are one of the layers recurring across the lines, and 和而不同 is among the responses recorded within the tradition; these later layers set a direction within relations.

account_adds.en: What exactly is lost and to whom, and that a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside, or by coining. Among exactly symmetric parties, who contributes is differentiated only by an actual asymmetry or a procedure, whose warrant is open: a law of roles, not of generation.

source_adds.en: 同则不继, the claim the entry turns on: no law says sameness ends generation. Also the SSBX theorem on 大同 and winner-take-all, not on the spine.

name.en: 礼运's indicators as coordination problems; production sufficient

sense.en: 老有所终 and the other three are not a perfect state but coordination problems of the form 'the resource exists and the distribution mechanism fails', each now with a technical programme. Production now suffices for everyone's basic needs, so the bottleneck moved from production to coordination. Marked conditional.

entries.quote: the resource exists and the distribution mechanism fails

reading.en: An empirical claim about the world and a reading of one text; the account makes neither. Nearest in form: whether any flow is possible is whether active members can together give each step's demand (`Flow.possible_iff_covers`), and division by exclusive footprints keeps a level; the premises on basic living conditions among J1 to J4, proposed by the AI, are a commitment and no report of what production suffices for. COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION keeps positional goods zero-sum and conserved stocks rivalrous. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The whole claim. It stands in the folder's sources, 大道之行 and the 2026-04-11 chat.

name.en: Scarcity as fixation; 内卷 from the cut, not the cake

sense.en: The scarcity worldview is a fixation that takes a survival strategy adequate to particular conditions as eternal truth; distribution still runs on scarcity-era logic and manufactures artificial scarcity to keep itself legitimate. So 内卷 comes from how the cake is cut. Stated in the argument, from the 2026-04-11 material, not as a numbered claim.

entries.quote: 内卷不是因为蛋糕不够大

reading.en: The frame has a home: starting from relations removes the fixed sum among independent owners, and no condition is silently taken as scarce. The further step does not follow. A cut bears on a level: under balance, exclusive footprints at every step keep it from falling, not shown of any actual division. It does not bear on position: rises total falls whatever the total, and among two or more a best response for position keeps nothing, not shown of actual races. [AI reading]

says.en: Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum divided among independent owners. It does not remove rivalry, and both are theorems. Reading [AI reading, D45]: positional goods stay zero-sum, and conserved stocks rivalrous.
Theorem (any type for the counting). Across every change of amounts the positions' rises total their falls; no change raises every part's position, and a part's rise needs another part's fall.
Theorem. Among two drawers or more a best response for position keeps nothing. It does not show that actual races are so played, or that drawing everything is wrong.
No condition is silently taken as owned, transferable, additive, scarce or commensurable; the World's natural-number amounts are a modelling choice.
Theorem (World: balance). With such a division at every step, the level never falls below its start. It does not show that an actual division is by exclusive footprints, or that the level rises.

account_adds.en: That a shared total does not dissolve rivalry over position.

source_adds.en: That 内卷 comes from how the cake is cut, which no law gives for position. Also scarcity as a fixation, and artificial scarcity maintained for legitimacy: an empirical claim the account does not make.

name.en: Environment selects struggle or cooperation

sense.en: Humans carry a struggle and a cooperation repertoire; environment rather than disposition decides which expresses, so sufficiency plus safety moves a society toward 大同 by default. Ren first says the modes are in the genes and accepts that what is coded is the switch, not the setting. Neuroscience supplied in conversation.

entries.quote: 足够富足，能过上好日子，就会自然走向大同的方向

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text joins them. Parts have form. Same carrier need not fix response, on one witness. A formation sparing what it waits on restores giving; without one, withholding stays. 06 reads 荀子 as setting the limit on the relation of desire and goods, in neither party. But the default fails for optima: those of rising orders take their whole capacity wherever something stands, however much, and only a set point stands at enough. On these laws the order's form decides, not abundance; actual human orders are not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (periphery, pre-spine module; witness). In a finite model two histories with the same carrier, differing in developmental order, form different connections; the same carrier and operations do not fix the same response function.
Theorem (any type). Restoring needs a formation that spares all it waits on, which gives from step 1 whatever the start; without one, total withholding stays.
Law (World; a mutual best response, existence not shown in general): each takes its whole capacity wherever something stands.
Theorem. Where an eligible outcome reaches the set point every optimum stands at it, whatever the room; below it, every optimum takes the part's whole capacity beyond.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: 荀子 '求而无度量分界，则不能不争': the limit is set on the relation of desires and goods, in neither party.

account_adds.en: That a set-point order still draws its shortfall and can break a dependence beyond it.

source_adds.en: The default direction under sufficiency, and the empirical claim about human repertoires. The folder itself marks this as not following from the ontology.

name.en: 大同 as a memory; agriculture removed the ceilings

sense.en: 大同 may be a memory: in abundant environments small mobile groups lived so by default, demand-sharing and the freedom to walk away capping accumulation. Agriculture removed those ceilings, not the disposition, so recovery is architectural, not moral. A historical conjecture, Ren's own, with Sahlins supplied in conversation.

entries.quote: Agriculture removed the ceilings, not the disposition.

reading.en: A historical conjecture with no counterpart. The history dossier, not live, says of the 礼运 passage that the text's telling of 大同 as a way once practised is narrative, not derivation. Taken as architecture, the recovery half goes to the next entry; the history stays here. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The whole historical claim; the row p-ru-liyun-da-tong-xiao-kang in history/CHINESE-SOURCES-AND-BECOMING.md addresses only the text's own telling.

name.en: Recovery by rebuilding removed negative feedbacks

source.locator: The theory in one paragraph; Register one

sense.en: 大同 is reachable by mechanism, not conversion: material sufficiency plus restored negative feedback (real exit, ceilings on accumulation, cheap verifiable trust, coordination not routed through a capturable centre) moves the default toward cooperation.

entries.quote: rebuild the removed negative feedbacks at scale

reading.en: The account's exits have this shape: carrying what acts do back into what selects the rule, reading beyond the share, pooling; suppressed feedback and blocked exit are read as a fault in organized relations. It states them narrower and without promise: no guarantee, each exit under hypotheses, none shown of an actual collective, several with a closing window, and material sufficiency is no exit in its table. 'Reachable by mechanism' becomes achievable under stated conditions. [AI reading]

says.en: Exits from the loops that lock a collective, each with its law, hypotheses and edge; 'Achievable under stated conditions: yes, for named exits, none shown to hold of an actual collective'. Always guaranteed: no.
Reading [AI reading, D48]: term limits, audits, courts and antitrust carry what an actor's acts do back into what selects the rule: pooling, not opposed interests.

Theorem (any type). A reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks the course after every reading step past it, a sufficient way out; where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of any size is absorbed.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: 利出一孔 makes everything hang on one giver, while two suppliers each suffice; what must be looked at is what intervening and not intervening each do to the whole relation.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: kept apart from an omission of the representation and from informed harm is a fault in organized relations (suppressed feedback, blocked exit).

account_adds.en: The edge of each exit, that where the reading is formed from the share a new reading is absorbed, and, for a capturable centre, that a member is needed exactly where it is the only member (07 §4.3).

source_adds.en: 大同 as reachable by mechanism, with material sufficiency as a lever, cheap verifiable trust and ceilings on accumulation: none modelled. Exit has one reading and no law. The folder also notes it has no account of what leaving costs a constituted self.

name.en: The target is the topology of feedback on drives

sense.en: Ren's self-correction: environment is not the whole story. Unchecked positive feedback on drives (status, dominance, acquisition, hatred) breaks a system regardless of abundance, so the target is the topology of the feedback the drive runs in, not the drive and not the environment alone.

entries.quote: drive如果可以channel到一个和谐幸福的方向，而不是corruption

reading.en: Same form on models: a loop closes a difference only through a link giving back less; draws exceeding all earlier draws need a stock of at least 2^n - 1, so abundance only buys steps; 'more than now' and 'above all others' have no rest. Stated of conditions and targets, not of human drives; how targets form is not modelled. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). Where every link gives on at least what it receives the difference never falls, so a loop closes a difference only through a link giving back less.
Theorem (World: balance, nothing given). Where each step's draw exceeds everything drawn since T, what stood at T is at least 2^n - 1. How fast an actual draw grows is not shown.

Theorem. 'More than now' is met only by change, and at every step needs an open world; 'above all others' is met by at most one seeker, so no unchanged state meets it for two. How a target forms is not modelled.
Theorem. The bound is exactly no overshoot; within it, opposing, the level settles at m; beyond it an opposing exchange crosses and can oscillate for ever.

account_adds.en: Exact conditions for closing, keeping or exceeding every bound, and a limit on negative feedback itself: a late or oversized opposing exchange does not settle.

source_adds.en: Status, dominance and hatred as the drives concerned, and channelling a drive toward happiness rather than removing it.

name.en: Shared symbols selected toward one root

sense.en: In a communication environment of 和, symbols shared across frameworks are selected toward a monist attractor, concepts traceable to a common root. So 大同 is no utopia but the direction in which language and existence automatically manifest, toward 理, good and 生生不息. Flagged by Ren as hypothesis, both premises.

entries.quote: 乃是一个语言与存在自动向理，向善，向生生不息的方向manifest

reading.en: The account takes up shared codes and says otherwise. Agreement comes from one origin or a broken symmetry, where origin means whose form is heard, not a root of concepts; being joined is not enough; the forms that can become shared are those in use; no law tests a form for reaching 理 or good, imposing a code agrees as well, and no law says a shared code is worth keeping. Joined accounts meet at a common refinement: finer, not one root. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). Where two forms differ, an order brings every start to agreement exactly where it gives all formations one origin; the forms that can become shared are exactly the forms in use. Being joined through couplings is not enough: on a path a – c – b, a and b never agree. How long agreement takes is not stated.
Theorem (any type). Imposing one code makes all agree in a step and keeps every exchange of formations: agreement from symmetry without a formation above the others, by privileging forms.
Theorem (any type). Majority adoption makes no form; two holding different forms both rest, so agreement needs a broken symmetry.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: writing as a reading system is strongly relational, but the graph itself encodes no relational ontology.

Theorem (any type). For incidence-connected scopes whose roots a bisimulation of their role frames relates, the matched fragment pairs form a common refinement covering both. A static law; no selection is stated.
No law says a drain is a harm, restraint better, cooperation good or a shared code worth keeping.

account_adds.en: What an agreed code costs, and that free-energy minimization breaks no symmetry.

source_adds.en: An attractor of communicating intelligences, and the joining of existence to language. The folder also says it is joined to register one by nothing yet.

name.en: Cooperation has to reason; struggle only has to win

sense.en: Once there is contention, 'I am right' and the I becomes greater than 理: cooperation must give reasons, struggle need only prevail. Ren's correction of his own premise, from an egalitarian environment to an environment of 和 rather than 争.

entries.quote: 合作才讲理，斗则讲赢

reading.en: Proposed here, of the second half only; no live text joins them: a rule read from the share it selects outlives a growing loss it does not read. That is only having to win where winners write the reading, proved in the model; on actual metrics T7 is conjectured, and in one trained system the bridge failed, a note of the loss turning the rule. The first half has no law; 07 tells closure from disagreement. 06 records 戴震's 以理杀人, so 理 alone is no safeguard. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). Where neither the next share nor the rule read reads the beyond, courses alike in share and rule stay alike; from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked.

Thesis T7: a metric whose rule and reading are formed from the share it selects is kept by its selectors however large a loss it does not read grows, and is dropped only through a change in what the loop reads. In the model only invariance and the lock are proved.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: 戴震's 以理杀人 is one standpoint's model applied where others' differences do not couple in; pooling the coupling of those affected fills that blind spot.
An account that read every objection as its objector's capture would take in no objection, and by the law of selection nothing an objector says could then reach it.

T7, on actual metrics: conjectured; in one trained system the lock formed, and the bridge, that its judge is a pool of readers read by kind, failed: notes of the loss on the disfavoured readers' answers turned its rule at each reading where they were read, the model's law standing only within its hypotheses.

Reading [AI reading, D65]: diagnosing closure first tells apart factual error, lack of capacity, evaluative or practical closure, real conflict with warranted limits, and substantive disagreement with no closure; without the last, 'closed' shields the theory from counterexamples.

account_adds.en: What turns such a course, T7's frozen test with its own standing, and method's rule that an objection is answered on what it says.

source_adds.en: That contention puts the I above 理 while cooperation must give reasons, and that an environment of 和 makes parties reason at all.

name.en: Evolving toward struggle is selected against

sense.en: Struggle-optimised traits (his example: males over-optimising appearance) go extinct when the environment changes, because they are not 生 and adapt poorly; accumulating toward the future, the 生 that is recognised, is 理. Marked conditional, Ren's own.

entries.quote: 当境变化的时候，这些就更可能会灭，因为它非生，适应性低

reading.en: The account takes up whether struggle ends the struggler, by another mechanism: the source has low adaptability when an environment changes, the laws an end through a drawn condition. Position does not protect a part depending on what the race draws down: it ends with the rest; a confined rise has no member after the end, known results restated. But in the clearing witness a greatest part not so depending continues, and in the witness Body an unconfined rise has a member later, so struggle is not selected against in general. That a race produces joint excess is a premise; selection has no tie to 生. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type for the counting; World for the race). Position does not protect a part requiring a condition past the joint excess. In a witness race the part rising in position ends with every other; in the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues. That a race for position produces joint excess is a premise here, not derived.

Theorem (World). A confined rise has no member after the end, whatever selection within had raised it to; in the witness Body the lineage depending on a condition outside the body still has a member. These restate known results on cancer and the germ line; that a given tumour meets the clauses is empirical.

account_adds.en: The condition under which a position-winner ends and the witness where it does not.

source_adds.en: Selection across environmental change and the low adaptability of struggle traits, the source's own mechanism, and accumulation toward the future as 理.

name.en: 一元 as return to one root, and plural

sense.en: 一元 is not cardinality but all concepts returning to one root. Many traditions do this and differ in which root: god, emptiness, struggle, extinction. 一生万物 is itself pluralism: monism at the root and plurality in the world are one claim.

entries.quote: 我说的一元当然不是基数，是所有概念回归同一root

reading.en: The grammar has this shape: one kind of symbol, a relation read as condition, sameness relative to a plural class. The word is not the source's: this root is a model's choice, not a ground concepts return to, and 06 lists a prior ground among non-relational layers. The account counts its own return: a few central results are cases of the root, more use its laws, most use none. Against a rival dropping the reading, a first count ties. [AI reading]

says.en: The chapter takes one relation, read as condition, and one class, read as sameness, and shows what their meet, continuation, carries.
Definition: a class is a reflexive, symmetric, transitive relation. Reading [AI reading, D69]: the class is plural; the grammar names the class and says everything relative to it.
Of the central results a few are cases of the root, more use its laws in their proofs and most use none.
Each of the 117 distinct central declarations has one standing against the edge of one root; eleven are derived, each a case of grammar laws.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: the theory never identifies 道 with any spine term; 无, 一, 二, 三 do not by comparison become the empty set, a bit or an operation.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: among the non-relational layers recurring in the lines, the first is a prior ground (先在的根据).

Thesis (philosophical, argued): reading a subject as continuation relative to a class explains how it goes on. A rival keeping every model and theorem and dropping the word loses no exclusion; on a first count there is a tie.

account_adds.en: A count of how far the return goes, and what would defeat the reading (08 §9).

source_adds.en: All concepts returning to one root, the comparative claim about what different religions return to, 一生万物 as truth, and monism at the root and plurality in the world as one claim.

name.en: Scale self-similarity: we are the collective

sense.en: We are in the system and are the system, so the 理 between us and the cells in our bodies is the same at that level. We may be individual but cannot disregard the collective, because we are it; all should behave as if part of the whole. Hence 人类命运共同体. Ren's own.

entries.quote: 我们可以"个人"，但不能不管集体，因为我们即是集

reading.en: The account refuses this form where it would matter: a shared process implies no cosmic subject and no aggregate interest, a collective is no unit with an interest, and part-whole is three relations, with no fixed ladder of scales. Nonduality is a requirement of method and proves no ethical necessity, so from 'we are the system' no 'should' follows; a ranking needs C, the condition fixing scope, neither asserted, warrant open. [AI reading]

says.en: Nonduality erases no difference in experience, history, access, control, consent or consequence. A shared process implies no cosmic subject, no aggregate interest and no administrator entitled to speak for everything.
Thesis: a collective is a region of formed relations, not a unit with an interest of its own; conflict and difference stay real.
Reading [AI reading, D65], Part and whole: inclusion, functional participation and dependence are distinct relations; cell, organ, body, ecosystem is one biological case, not a fixed ladder.
Classified by AI as a divergence of standing: 程颢's 仁者以天地万物为一体 is stated as a recognized fact, what the theory holds as an unasserted condition plus the step of invariance.
Nonduality is a requirement of method; it proves neither the ontology nor an ethical necessity.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: in 《维摩诘所说经》 care need not first take the other as one's own part, nor can it be inferred only from one shared substance.

account_adds.en: That a law across scales needs its own relation, and that an intervention on a whole needs an admissible realization.

source_adds.en: One 理 across scales, and behaving as part of the whole as what follows.

name.en: One civilisation, one global system

sense.en: There is one civilisation and one global system, societies its subsystems, and the us-against-others stance ('I'm the biggest ... those shall be mine') has to go. Spoken, from an automatic transcript, Ren provisionally Speaker B.

entries.quote: We only have one global system that we are subsystems of that system.

reading.en: The factual half is the account's, as a reading of what is empirical: human beings plausibly lie in one another's feeding closures, and that the Earth is mutually dependent is supplied, not shown. That scope reaches nothing after the step it is read up to. 'Has to go' is not said: rivalry stays, positional goods stay zero-sum, and an order needs C or a premise in its place, the condition fixing only scope, neither asserted, warrant open. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D64]: through one atmosphere, biosphere and economy, human beings plausibly lie within one another's feeding closures; if so, every human being's self-concern, held de se and drawn along what carries it, has one scope there. Whether they do is empirical.

Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum divided among independent owners. It does not remove rivalry, and both are theorems. Reading: positional goods stay zero-sum, conserved stocks rivalrous.
Theorem (World). A web's closures can be the whole in three ways: sharing conditions throughout, mutual dependence, mutual feeding. That the Earth is mutually dependent is supplied.

account_adds.en: What 'one system' can and cannot give self-concern, read with time.

source_adds.en: That the us-against-others stance has to go, and cultures' common teaching of limits on desire (claim 45).

name.en: 修齐治平 as capacity-responsibility matching

sense.en: 修身齐家治国平天下 is not sequence but whether I have the capacity and standing to act: an ordering by causal radius, responsibility lying where capacity reaches. Bounded: blaming the powerless yields only self-reproach; pleading weakness to refuse feasible good is evasion. Weight in deciding grows with capacity.

entries.quote: 力之所及，责之所在

reading.en: Bounded responsibility is a further premise beyond the condition (scope) and C (order), neither asserted and warrant open, from named, limited sources, not from capacity as such; responsibility is not shown to differentiate within relations. Reach, whose losses count and answerability stay apart. Two forms match: an empty plan set generates no duty; 06's proposed answer to 差等, attention divided by reach, survives the step of invariance, with no law. 大学's necessary direction stays a condition chain where the source denies sequence. [AI reading]

says.en: Argument, reviewed and scoped. Responsibilities arise from named sources, each limited; an empty plan set generates no duty, a contribution is indispensable only where every admissible allocation requires it. Bounded responsibility is among J1 to J4, further premises proposed by the AI (as COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION §4 lists them).
One unfolding is a thesis, argued: within relations, as far as shown, taker and drawn-on are two roles of one relatum and knower and known one loop, and responsibility is not shown to differentiate.
Reading [AI reading, D45]: capability is reach, and the gap is the reach closure less the coupling closure, so capability extending reach without extending the coupling enlarges the gap.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: 大学 '其本乱而末治者否矣', the necessary side holds; '身修而后家齐', the sufficient side does not generally hold.
Responsibility needs its own argument: historical contribution alone does not prove it, and its absence does not prove that there is no reason to respond.

Row 差等 (孟子 亲亲而仁民; 中庸 亲亲之杀): no law. Reading [AI reading, D54]: closures nest in fact; read as a ranking of significance that is not a theorem. Proposed answer: attention divided by what one reaches survives the step of invariance; a measure of significance set by standpoint does not.

sense.en: The scaling rule for power inverts the usual one: those of largest causal radius owe most. Even the largest is 天子, whose being should make the relations of 天下 harmonious and prosperous. The folder keeps it as a ledger the largest is judged by, not a guardian to be trusted, an obligation and not a mechanism.

name.en: A ledger of meaning changes what consolidated power is rewarded for

sense.en: Where meaning rests on moving history in a better direction rather than on dominance, the reward system changes when power is consolidated. So a civilisation's ledger of meaning decides which self-model selection favours at the top: the 大同 mechanism stated as selection. Spoken, conditional.

entries.quote: A civilisation's ledger of meaning decides what consolidated power is rewarded for

reading.en: Proposed here, reading a ledger as what the rule reads; no live text does. It holds where the reading is not formed from the share: a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks; one formed monotonically from the share absorbs any change. Theorem (counts). The others read a loss once it reaches a bound; at a reading step where the loss has reached it and the rule in force favours the shapers, the course is locked in their favour for good from the next step exactly under the stated condition. COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION §2: once the late reading would favour the shapers, every later reading keeps the lock.

source_adds.en: Meaning as what sets reward, the ledger itself, and the civilisational scale.

name.en: 仁义礼智信 as one layered structure

sense.en: The five are layers of cooperative existence, fractal not sequential: 仁 the relational root (人+二), 义 fittingness asking at whose cost, 礼 transmissible form, 智 situational discernment, 信 temporal consistency at the centre. Each degrades when cut from 仁. Inherited structure; Ren's the question. They also answer a relational agent's practical questions.

entries.quote: 仁以成我，义以安位，礼以共行，智以辨向，信以守真

reading.en: Mostly absent, and the account declines two of the five as names. 06 omits 仁 as carrying value and sets 仁 and 义 as names on neither side of its table; 礼 and 信 stand only as interfaces in 文理生生. Not adopting is not excluding: their texts are still classified. 06 lists relational roots (郑玄 on 仁, 荀子 on 礼) and warns that skilled control may be 不仁. The layering and 信 at the centre are absent. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D54]: every line has a relational root, among them 郑玄 reading 仁者人也 as the 人 of 相人偶, and 荀子's 礼起于度量分界.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: 德 read as a formed, still revisable capacity of response; reliable execution can reliably harm, so its ethical sense passes through comparison.
善, 恶 and 智 have no formal predicate; 足 is nearest to the rest of seeking (`Law.rests_iff`).

Its names omit 37 characters, each for a reason, among them 道 (as origin, a prior ground), 心 (a single ruler), 性 (a preset nature), 仁 (carries value). Not adopting is not excluding: the texts they stand in are still classified by what they say.
Table: set as names on neither side (16): 道、气、性、仁、义、天、有、无、阴、阳. Not set here, set in 文理生生 as an interface (7): 易、德、礼、信、虚、反、人.
Reading [AI reading]: even skilled control may be 不仁: selection reaches only what couples in.

account_adds.en: That no virtue's goodness is given by its reliability.

source_adds.en: The five as one layered structure, 信 as time and centre, each one's degradation, and the folder's question of whether they are description, prescription or scaffold.

name.en: 大道废，有仁义: named virtues as scaffolding

sense.en: Read constructively: civilisation compresses the Great Way into named virtues once it stops being visible in shared life. They can repair a civilisation and cannot replace the Way, and degenerate if cut from it. This explains why moral vocabulary proliferates as moral reality thins. From the AI-drafted book.

entries.quote: 支架者，大道之局部压缩，可以修补文明，不可代大道

reading.en: The passage has no row in the live account, nor in the history dossier by either written form. Its form needs a 'Way' prior to named norms, near what 06 records as a non-relational layer. Nearest, and not this claim: method's step of telling a change in the actual condition from one in its report, label or proxy; that a changed reward, name or preference is not fulfilment; a rule read from the share outliving what it was for. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The whole reading.

name.en: The convergence across traditions names one object

sense.en: Confucian, Ubuntu, Buddhist, Indigenous, cybernetic and ecological traditions converge on one object, which Ren names the structure of cooperative existence for finite beings; 'today we are so mad we lost it collectively'.

entries.quote: the structure of cooperative existence for finite beings

reading.en: For the Chinese lines checked, the account says less and otherwise: a relational root in every line, its universal form often needing scope, and as a property of each system false, with four non-relational layers recurring, each answered within its tradition. It names no convergent object: 相合不是印证, agreement is no confirmation, and shared form is not shared meaning. review/BUDDHIST-THOUGHT compares passages under its own recorded weaknesses; Ubuntu and Indigenous lines are not compared. [AI reading]

says.en: Assessment; the classes and readings are AI's [AI reading, D54]: relational ontology is a leading thread in these traditions and a position within each; it is not a property of every system nor the consensus of the commentaries. Scope slightly exceeds agreement, 98 to 91.

Not shown: that language or tradition is relational by nature: the relational start is a leading thread, strongest in the earliest layer, not a property of every system.

account_adds.en: Counted relations by passage, and the non-relational layers: a prior ground, a preset nature or value, a will or single ruler, contention and rank.

source_adds.en: The naming of the object, and Ubuntu, Indigenous and other lines as partners in one convergence.

name.en: A community needing no shared definition of the good

sense.en: 人类命运共同体 requires no transfer of sovereignty, only mutual trust and consensus, at every scale, and no shared definition of the good future: cultures differ, and helping one another beats contending to be king. Its core is 家国天下, and it must absorb markets and technology. Ren's value stance.

entries.quote: 真正的命运共同体不需要主权让渡，需要的是彼此信任共识

reading.en: One clause has a form: differing valuers need no common utility, since every positive weighting shares widening. Exactly this much: they share no verdict on mixed cases, the hard ones, and valuing positively is C's premise relocated, with the condition for scope, neither asserted, warrant open. 'Better than contending' is unranked if contending is mixed. Trust and consensus as sufficient are not said: coupling is not compliance, and all six conditions of situationality still rank nothing. Sovereignty is not taken up. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem. The order shared by standpoints whose orders increase in admission is exactly widening, and calling it better is C. A mixed comparison is decided both ways. Monotonicity at the standpoint is C's premise relocated.
Thesis: joint activity is explained from actual relations, not opposed interests, bargaining or a fixed common utility.
Seeing is not valuing, and coupling is not compliance; all six conditions together still rank nothing.

account_adds.en: The exact limit of agreement among differing valuers, and evidence (T5) with frozen rules passed and failed.

source_adds.en: Trust and consensus as sufficient, no sovereignty transfer, 家国天下, and markets and technology to be absorbed.

name.en: 共开 ∧ 共续 ∧ ¬夺共续, a checked characterisation

sense.en: 人类命运共同体 is three independent Boolean axes, with an iff over eight states and three counterexamples: 245 lines of Lean, 0 sorry, 0 new axioms, in the SSBX development. 命, 运, 体 are re-expressed from existing roots, not admitted as primitives. Its own report: not a political manifesto formalised. The folder warns it proves less than its placement suggests.

entries.quote: three independent axes, all three or nothing

reading.en: The formalism is not on the spine, and the account says why two of its terms are not mapped: openness indexed to a focus hands openness to owners, against starting from one relational unfolding, and 夺 is stated through such openness; capture carries that content instead. The theory sets up no formal 道, so TrueDao and 道 ⊕ 人类 have no counterpart. The discipline against importing primitives survives as method. [AI reading]

says.en: Mechanism: two early items are not mapped, openness indexed by a focus, which allots openness to owners against the method, and 夺, stated through each focus's openness; as capture of a selection it is at target capture.
Theorem (any type). Where target carriers each leave at least a offspring and others at most b < a, the carriers' offspring stand to the others' strictly more than the carriers to the others.
This theory sets up no formal 道; 善, 恶 and 智 have no formal predicate.

account_adds.en: Comparison instead of definition: whether a closing supports or damages 生生 comes through comparison, with the condition for scope and C for order, both unasserted.

source_adds.en: The community's three-axis model, kept outside the account; `Renlei` has no hit in the live text.

name.en: Dualism as root of the totalising dynamic

sense.en: The metaphysical root of the totalising dynamic is the subject-object split and treating 'the subject wants good for itself' as definitionally rational, a tradition-specific commitment mistaking itself for universal. The folder also records the objection that selection would act on relational cognition too. Ren's value stance.

entries.quote: The metaphysical root of the totalising dynamic is dualism

reading.en: The account makes no causal claim from ontology to harm. Its capture and drain laws hold of any type and selection, so they need no dualism; 06 finds a relational method with a contending direction in 兵家 and 法家; starting from relations removes one frame, not rivalry. It will not use the charge as an answer: that an objection presupposes separate entities must be shown in the case, and nonduality proves neither the ontology nor an ethical necessity. [AI reading]

says.en: Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum divided among independent owners. It does not remove rivalry, and both are theorems.
AI classification: 兵家 and 法家 have the highest share of divergence, 8 of 13; the method is relational, the direction contending.
An objection is answered on what it says. That it presupposes separate entities, or follows a tradition or a thinker, is a claim to be shown in the case, not an answer to it.
Subject and object, actor and patient, fact and value are each drawn within the unfolding, along relations, together with what they leave out.
Nonduality is a requirement of method; it proves neither the ontology nor an ethical necessity.
08 marks a field's frame where it cites one: Frank's race, over-allocation being that field's frame.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: without substantive disagreement with no closure, 'closed' shields the theory from counterexamples.

account_adds.en: Mechanism without a metaphysical cause: what selects, what couples in, what the rule reads.

source_adds.en: A causal claim from ontology to the dynamic, and the historical critique of rational self-interest.

name.en: Institutional codification as the totalising step

sense.en: Dualism is necessary but not sufficient: dualistic medieval Christendom did not generate Moloch at scale, partly non-dualistic dynastic China extracted at scale, and the totalising step is codification: property and inheritance, money as universal equivalent, corporate personhood. AI pushback adopted.

entries.quote: the totalising step is the *institutional codification* of dualism's implications

reading.en: No such historical claim, and not because the topic is missing. Money and ownership are kept for actual economic relations; a periphery model takes joint activity selected through payments; capture through a rule is proved, with 韩非's 二柄 beside it; and 07 reads the imperial examination as a case that became a proxy trap of its own. None says codification is the totalising step, or compares Christendom with dynastic China. Personhood and inheritance have no place. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The historical comparison and the named institutions.

name.en: Asymmetric scrutiny of non-Western vocabulary

sense.en: Western political vocabulary travels as unmarked universal while non-Western terms are flagged 'from culture X': a standing reading error, first caught on 命运共同体. The folder adds that it cuts both ways: a culture label on a dynamic is its mirror image, and 大同 carries state associations for outside readers.

Nothing rules on political vocabulary, and no law is involved. Its practice cuts both ways, as the folder asks: 06 records divergence by passage and reads no tradition as relational by nature. [AI reading]

says.en: No cultural origin validates or disqualifies a method. An objection is answered on what it says. That it presupposes separate entities, or follows a tradition or a thinker, is a claim to be shown in the case, not an answer to it.
08 marks a field's frame where it cites one: Frank's race, over-allocation being that field's frame.
Not shown: that language or tradition is relational by nature: the relational start is a leading thread, not a property of every system.

source_adds.en: The rule stated for political vocabulary (liberalism, democracy, market, social contract), its first catch on 命运共同体, and that 大同 carries state associations for outside readers.

name.en: AI must not be used for struggle

sense.en: The root position of the 智善 organisation: AI must not be used for struggle; intelligence belongs to all humanity, for building 大同世界 and everyone's welfare. Stated flatly as a stance.

entries.quote: 人工智能不能被用于斗争，智能用于所有人类

reading.en: The account takes up AI and contest and gives only a conditional direction, under the continuation condition (scope), C read as widening (order), J1 to J4 and correspondence E, all unasserted, warrant open. It forbids no use by itself: who restrains stays contested, positional goods stay zero-sum. Pooling couplings across intelligences is a route to alignment for all, not the whole of it. The source's flat root position, no AI in struggle, is not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: Conditional (the continuation condition for scope, C read as widening for order, J1–J4, correspondence E). The direction proposed: align AI formation, learning, action and revision with actual living and further generation within the whole, governing trade-offs through real losses, basic living conditions, bounded responsibility and legitimate participation.

Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum and does not remove rivalry. Reading [AI reading, D45]: the theory adds to who wins more whether the joint draw stays within the renewal and others' margins; who restrains stays contested.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: pooling couplings across intelligences, so that what a member's acts do beyond its closure couples into a member able to respond, is a route to alignment for all, not the whole of it.

targets.part: D68: the law of several optimizers
