account_adds.en: What holds with no premise: what a selection reaches, and that several optimizers drain by their joint capacity.

source_adds.en: The refusal of contest uses as a root position, and intelligence as belonging to all.

name.en: 大同 as ontological implication; alignment isomorphic to it

sense.en: Alignment and 大同 are isomorphic at three levels: floor, not oriented toward the bad; middle, the field within [平, 和]; upper, flourishing across AI, humans and ecosphere. And 大同 is the ontological implication of 間: actors with interwoven worldlines in a shared 間 are already in a community of destiny.

entries.quote: 「大同」不是间的远期愿景，「大同」是间的本体论 implication

reading.en: Ontology implies no such thing in the account: being joined gives mutual dependence, which is not mutual benefit, and no law or premise entails a community from a net. Nonduality proves neither the ontology nor an ethical necessity. 間 as a primitive has been replaced by the grammar of the root. A direction for alignment stands only under premises, the condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted, warrant open. No isomorphism is stated. [AI reading]

says.en: Section heading text: read the closures of the map as the whole; mutual dependence is not mutual benefit.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: the early scheme of 文言 as formal language, with an original 間, has been replaced by the grammar of the root, and its claim of completeness was not proved.
Conditional (the continuation condition for scope, C read as widening for order, J1–J4, correspondence E): the direction proposed for AI.
Nonduality is a requirement of method; it proves neither the ontology nor an ethical necessity.

account_adds.en: A condition on the net for each sense of being joined, and why any ought is added apart.

source_adds.en: The three-level isomorphism and the spacetime reading of 命运.

name.en: The relational self does not entail the 大同 mechanism

source.locator: Open questions, 'New, from this reading'; Status

sense.en: The folder's own critique: nothing in relational constitution entails that abundance moves a society toward cooperation; that is an empirical claim about drives and feedback. The two registers, behaviour and symbols, are never joined, and the document reads as though the second follows from the first. Written by the assistant reading the folder.

entries.quote: Nothing in the ontology of relational constitution entails that abundance moves a society toward cooperation

reading.en: The account states the general form of this concession. Its thesis of one unfolding excludes no observation, a root law holds of every relation, and content comes through hypotheses; mutual dependence is not mutual benefit; and informed harm tests the inference from one unfolding to goodwill. So what the folder concedes at one joint holds at each: no empirical direction follows from the ontology. Nothing here speaks of abundance. [AI reading]

says.en: By this section's measure the thesis has no strength: it excludes no observation, and the argument is that none could refute it. That is argued, not proved.
A law of the theory is a statement that holds of every relation, carrier or model its hypotheses admit; it is read off what it holds of and does not stand over it.
The section's opening: mutual dependence is not mutual benefit.

Reading [AI reading, D65]: informed harm, a harmful arrangement kept knowingly, no loss returning, is the hard rival, which tests the inference from one unfolding to goodwill without refuting normative grounds.

account_adds.en: That the relational form, by its own measure, has no strength; what can fail stands in named theses.

source_adds.en: The proposal that joining the two registers, selection on behaviour and on the symbols that coordinate it, is the most valuable work here.

name.en: The bounded self as the disease: cancer logic

sense.en: The disease is a self-model: a you caring only for what you perceive as you, modelling 'even more', pursued without seeing what you and your world are; compounding, this is cancer logic. Humans can develop such an alienated, cancerous or evil ego, a capacity and no fixed nature. Selection, molochlization, rewards it. Spoken; automatic transcript.

entries.quote: there is a you that you only you cares about what you perceive as you

reading.en: Mechanism carried, evaluation and interior not. A selection reaches only what couples in; omitting a required condition, a draw can lose its own support; a confined rise ends. The source's 'without seeing' is omission; 07 keeps informed harm apart as the hard rival, and seeing is not valuing. The position is not a defect, how a center represents its region is unmodelled, and no law says a loss is a harm. On acts or interior: choices show only their reach of an order. [AI reading]

says.en: Thesis T3: a selection through couplings reaches only what couples into its selector, and with room its optima drain what lies beyond as far as any eligible outcome does. The law for optima is proved; the clause on trained systems is conjectured, partly supported.

Theorem (World). Omitting a required condition, its own draw can lose its own support; over a region covering what it requires it keeps its own and can still undermine another. How a center represents the region is unmodelled.
Reading [AI reading, D26]: the position is not a defect; 无明 is the seeking it leaves locked.

targets.part: D26: the position is no defect

says.en: Theorem (root; near-definitional). The positive comparisons every strict order according with the choices shares are exactly the reach of what they show. Which order an actual chooser carries, or whether it chooses by one, is not shown.
Reading [AI reading, D65]. Kept apart: an omission of the representation, a fault in organized relations, and informed harm (a harmful arrangement kept knowingly, no loss returning), the hard rival.
Seeing is not valuing: enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate, not which differences matter.

Theorem (World). A confined rise has no member after the end, whatever selection within had raised it to. These restate known results on cancer and the germ line; that a given tumour meets the clauses is empirical.

account_adds.en: A narrower self-model can keep its own support and still undermine another, so own loss does not decide the case.

source_adds.en: The ego as cognitive structure, greed and anger as the moments it takes over, and the word disease.

name.en: Deciding from relations, not from a target

sense.en: A relational decision begins from present relations, constraints and what can be done, not from optimising a target around one value. A target-first decision draws a boundary round what it counts; where winning compounds, selection favours it, while a relations-first decider bears the costs. The joining is the assistant's reading, citing a formal proposition in a paper.

entries.quote: 而不是围绕某一个价值，去优化一个既定的目标

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text joins them. The target-first half matches T3's law, and an act beyond one's closure is selected by no member. Extending the coupling is necessary, not sufficient: where the rest outruns the renewal no weight selects a member's restraint. The relations-first half is not a law: the account has no such procedure, though its further premises, added to the condition (scope) and C (order), neither asserted, warrant open, begin from feasible plans, and a model and an order can act alike where no selection tells them apart. An objective is a selector and an order, not a scope. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World). An act whose difference stays beyond the actor's coupling closure is selected alike by every selection through the coupling of any member of the closure, the actor among them.
Theorem (any types; a witness). Two blanketed laws related so that values sensed and acts are one give the same values and acts at every step, so no selection through those tells the two apart.
AI reading: an objective is a selector and an order, not a scope; read as a correspondence not shown, an optimizer's objective resembles the intended self.
Conditional (living significance, J1 to J4, correspondence E): responsibilities arise from named sources, each limited; an empty plan set generates no duty.

Necessary, not sufficient. Extending the coupling is necessary for a consequence beyond the actor's closure to be selected, but where the rest outruns the renewal no weight of a later reading selects a member's restraint.

account_adds.en: The folder's own point sharpened: a frame alone changes no selection.

source_adds.en: The procedure itself, its starting questions, and that relational reasoning's costs lose under compounding.

name.en: Ordinary competition is not the disease: the wolf

sense.en: Asked if all competition is bad, Ren narrows the target to a cognitive structure. The wolf's existence is not just about the wolf, and it does not eat to get bigger: ecological competition is part of an ecosystem. Spoken; automatic transcript.

entries.quote: the existence of the wolf is not just about the wolf

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text joins them. The line the source draws by what the eating is for has a form in the shape of an order: a set-point optimum stands at enough, whatever the room; a rising order takes its whole capacity; 'more than now' has no rest. That is of orders and optima, not wolves or interiors, and below its point a set-point order can break a dependence. Predation stays mixed; the whole-run reading under C, with the condition for scope, neither asserted, warrant open, ranks malignant and winning alike. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem. Where an eligible outcome reaches the set point every optimum stands at it, whatever the room; below it, every optimum takes the part's whole capacity beyond. What protects what lies beyond at the set point is the choice among equal optima, which no law here models.
Theorem. 'More than now' is met only by change, and at every step needs an open world. How a target forms is not modelled.
足 is nearest to the rest of seeking (`Law.rests_iff`).

Under the condition every narrowing loses something with significance. Predation, apoptosis and ending a cancer, read as losing and opening something, are mixed [AI reading, D65]; telling harm from non-harm among them needs a measure. No ending is licensed.

Conditional (C; World). Read whole-run, the course without an overdrawing formation extends the course with it, so every comparison satisfying C ranks it higher, for a malignant and a winning focal formation alike; read event by event the two are incomparable.

account_adds.en: That the ranking turns on the reading, whole-run or event by event, and on C; that telling harm from non-harm among such endings needs a measure.

source_adds.en: A difference in kind between the wolf and the ego, by what the eating is for, and the word disease for one side only.

name.en: 心 and 理 as one dynamic in the person

sense.en: Feeling and reason are not opposed: they form one dynamic, 心理, in which 理 keeps 心's positive feedback from running away. The good side is innate and has to be shaped. A constructive reading of the compound, from a monologue quoted through a translation; supplied by Ren as his own, not confirmed by ear.

entries.quote: 感受和理性也不是二分的

reading.en: One record reads this very sentence, so by descent: reason regulating the heart's runaway becomes a loop blind to its own margin, avoided by measurement, a model (理) or another formation's couplings. That is regulation by what the loop lacks, and need not be inside. The account has no interior of a person, and feeling is no term of it; 理 in 03 is lumping. 'Innate good' meets 06's layer of a preset nature. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): how far off the break is does not couple in. The record's readings (the AI's, on delegation): a runaway is a loop through whose own couplings, before the break, the world is alike with one holding as much more stock as one likes; avoiding it needs measurement, a model (理) or another formation's couplings; this reads Ren's words of 4 October that reason must regulate the heart.
Theorem. The bound is exactly no overshoot; within it, opposing, the level settles at m; beyond it an opposing exchange crosses and can oscillate for ever.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: 心即理, in context, is the responsive side within a relation, not an ontology of 心.

source_adds.en: Feeling and reason as one dynamic inside the person, the reading of 心理 as 心 and 理, and the good side as innate. It stands in this folder and `drives-narrative-attractors-and-mind`, by the folder's own Relations.

name.en: 逍遥: no independent self when the model fits

source.locator: Claim 53; own words 64-66; What fit is like

sense.en: When one's model fits reality one is nearer 逍遥; self and environment are one, there is no independent self, only forces in motion. The folder's epistemic reading, marked the assistant's: the separate self belongs to a model drawing a boundary the world does not have. Quoted through a translation.

entries.quote: 因此，也就没有一个独立的“自我”。

reading.en: The account forbids explaining by a self with a nature of its own, yet keeps boundaries: one short of the whole is real, relative to its relation. So a fitted model keeps its boundary. The folder's test, no cost returning through an ignored coupling, has a law's form and its limit: a region covering what it requires keeps its own support and can still undermine another, so passing shows fit only to one's own needs. What fit is like meets a named defeater. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45, D61]: a boundary short of the whole is real, since its relation never crosses it, and relative to that relation.

Thesis, argued: forbids an explanation needing a determination no relation carries, such as a self with a nature of its own. Two live arguments would defeat it: that relations need relata with natures of their own, and that what an experience is like is not how it relates.
Nonduality erases no difference in experience, history, access, control, consent or consequence.

Theorem (World). Over a region covering what it requires a center keeps its own support and can still undermine another (`Clearing`); omitting a required condition, its own draw can lose its own support (`Omitted.loses_own`). How a center represents the region is unmodelled.
Reading [AI reading, D17]: with no condition, 'should' is what a center does once its represented boundary matches what it depends on (route (b)).

account_adds.en: The several closures, nested or pointing opposite ways, each drawing a boundary of its own.

source_adds.en: What fit is like from inside, mind and body one, only forces in motion, and 逍遥 as its name, which has no live hit.

name.en: 己所不欲 from knowing others' minds resemble one's own

sense.en: The golden rule follows from knowing that one's own 心理 resembles others': a route through theory of mind, beside a route in 生生不息论 through what returns via the system. From the translated monologue.

entries.quote: 你也知道，自己的心理与其他人的心理很相似

reading.en: A spine reading of the verse exists only in the history dossier: 恕 selects through a model lumping the other with oneself, so it is right exactly where the other's likes vary as one's own, and blind to difference elsewhere. So the source's premise is the rule's scope, not its proof. Live 03 states the law with no verse: a selection through a map is right about what matters only where what matters goes alike across it. [AI reading]

name.en: The tradition's two engineerings, and needing to win

source.locator: Claim 56; The tradition's two tracks; critiques

sense.en: The tradition holds a social engineering for relations (儒) and, for struggle, 法家 and 《孙子兵法》, grounded in theory of mind, knowing conflict escalates and so not pursuing extremes; in the present order 'we really do need to win'. The folder records this against Ren's own self-critique of 外儒内法.

entries.quote: 在这个过程中，我们确实需要赢

reading.en: The account keeps the relational method and registers the direction as divergence: reading a situation relationally, pointed at one standpoint's advantage. Capture through the rule is proved, with 韩非's 二柄 beside it, which in another form is the folder's split of Legalism as evidence for mechanism and as a programme. Two seekers of 'above all others' cannot rest together, so refusing extremes has a law's form. 'Need to win' is not said: rise needs fall, and no order is read from that. [AI reading]

says.en: AI classification: 兵家 and 法家 have the highest share of divergence, 8 of 13: 势 is configuration and 参 a joint use of channels, the method relational, the direction contending.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: one victory cuts and does not stop the loop; 犹有晋在 is 两个以“高于其余一切”为目标的寻求者, unable to rest together. Its frame is power's, recorded as divergence.
Row, capture through a rule: 韩非 二柄; 管子 据有余而制不足; 商君书 壹. Proved, at 02's capture through the rule.

account_adds.en: Which parts of those texts match laws, passage by passage.

source_adds.en: The judgement about the present order, that we really do need to win; the two tracks as complementary competences; and the folder's recorded tension: 外儒内法 elsewhere listed as a degeneration.

name.en: The kernel's own degenerations

source.locator: Counterexamples, 'The Chinese kernel has its own degenerations'; own words 11-12

sense.en: Ren raises against himself: 外儒内法, extreme pragmatism, the weight of face and position, and that Confucian logic historically became the value system of whoever held power, especially in prosperous periods. He does not resolve this and holds high points and degenerate modes as coexisting.

entries.quote: the tradition supplies the vocabulary and the failure modes together

reading.en: The account names no degenerations of a kernel, and nothing on Confucian logic becoming power's value. A proposal only: 06 holds that same-word counterexamples must enter an explanation (韩非以德为庆赏，不能删成“没谈真正的道”). 07 reads the imperial examination as designed against hereditary capture and later a proxy trap of its own, resting on the capture laws: D68, the meta-attractor line's example, so by descent. A tradition turning so would have that form only if its reading comes from its carriers' share. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The whole: that Confucian logic became the value system of whoever held power, 外儒内法 and face as this kernel's failure modes, and holding high points and degenerate modes as coexisting. It stands in this folder and `human-solutions-museum`.

name.en: 人类命运共同体 accepted on its merits; official formulas continue the kernel

sense.en: The narrative is accepted regardless of sponsor's motive and articulated apart from state framing. Later: official formulas (人类命运共同体, AI 向善) continue the 大同 kernel, policy runs 小康 to 大同. Marked contested; the folder proposes one standard for all polities and notes the official sequence is Ren's reading.

entries.quote: 我认可这个叙事本身，不论隐藏动机，它是我们现在需要的一条出路

reading.en: The account judges no polity's narrative and names no state. The folder's own ruling, that theory texts argue about the dynamic and not about a pair of states, is what the account does. Nearest to accepting a narrative whatever its sponsor: an objection is answered on what it says, no cultural origin validates or disqualifies a method, and a description of participation confers no authority. A quotation in 06 is evidence of a word's sense, no ground of a claim. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The whole. Held as open in the folder and `OPEN-QUESTIONS.md`, not in the account.

name.en: Shaping a people's expectations as most legitimate

sense.en: Shaping a society's expectations, language and political expression, which the West calls propaganda, carries values leading a people as a whole and has the most legitimacy and historical height. Recorded by the folder as a value stance in tension with claim 30, not a result, with legitimacy proposed to come from contestability instead.

entries.quote: 这类东西才最具有正当性（legitimacy）和历史高度。

reading.en: The account's pieces run against the claim and with the folder's answer: later endorsement cannot authorize the formation that produced it, endorsement does not erase a loss, readers drawn from what a rule selects lock it, and no criterion of legitimate change is supplied. Its conditional direction, under the condition (scope), C (order) and further premises, all unasserted, warrant open, asks for effective chances to challenge and revise. It speaks of formation generally and judges no polity. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65]: later endorsement cannot authorize the formation that produced it.
Conditional (the condition, C read as widening, J1 to J4, correspondence E): legitimate participation, with effective opportunities to understand, challenge and revise.

Theorem (counts). The rule after shaping read as the pool of its readers' readings: it reads the share monotonically exactly where lo ≤ hi, and against it where hi ≤ lo. The premise of the loop is moved to who reads, not removed.

Conditional (the condition for scope; C and the practical commitments for order; an argument): ends, evaluations and the rules selecting future intelligence enter the same appraisal; endorsement does not erase a loss.

name.en: The struggle comes with scale, not with a people

source.locator: Claim 62; What is generic, and what is his

sense.en: The struggle is neither the West's nature nor humanity's; the possibility arises once very large societies with many dynamic processes exist. Offered by the monologue as its own correction of its East-West framing; the folder follows it and argues about the dynamic.

entries.quote: 这种斗争并不是西方的本色，更不是人类的本色。

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text joins them. The laws of race and position hold of any drawers with no culture in them, which is the form of the correction: among two or more, a best response for position keeps nothing, not shown of actual races. 06 finds a contending direction inside Chinese lines too, so it goes by no people. The tie to a society's size is not stated: number enters, size as such does not. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem. Among two drawers or more a best response for position keeps nothing. With one drawer every profile is perfect. It does not show that actual races are so played, or that drawing everything is wrong.
AI classification: 兵家 and 法家 have the highest share of divergence, 8 of 13; the method is relational, the direction contending.

account_adds.en: That with one drawer the race law has no force: number enters, size as such does not.

source_adds.en: Scale as the historical cause, which is the correction itself.

name.en: Characters record inter-tribal convergence

sense.en: Chinese characters record inter-tribal communication through symbols that converged on agreed denotations, evolving as memes; 止戈为武 is an example. Marked conjecture; the folder itself says the etymology is contested, and that the example should not be offered as evidence. Conjecture 2 of the SSBX README is related.

entries.quote: The conjecture stays tiered as conjecture, and the etymology should not be offered as evidence for it.

reading.en: The folder's caution is the account's reading: 武's graph-history and the 左传 line are two layers, and the graph encodes no relational ontology. What holds is narrower: a code forms between formations by hearings, under conditions, proved of any type, with 约定俗成 and 书同文 listed beside it; a resolution written back into records later cohorts read rests from the next cohort on. The history of negotiating tribes is neither taken up nor denied. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D54]: 止 is a foot, 武 holding a halberd and walking; 止戈为武 is 楚庄王's value interpretation. The theory does not say 武 originally means stopping halberds.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: most characters are phonetic compounds; the graph itself encodes no relational ontology.

Theorem (any type). Where two forms differ, an order brings every start to agreement exactly where it gives all formations one origin. Table: a resolution written back into the records that later cohorts read rests from the next cohort on.
Row, a code formed between formations (约定俗成): 荀子 同则同之, 名无固宜; 止戈之说的写回; 书同文. Proved, at 05.

account_adds.en: Four kinds of correspondence for characters, and acceptance levels.

source_adds.en: The history of negotiating tribes, characters as its record, and characters evolving as memes. Conjecture 2 of the SSBX README is related.

name.en: Cultural observations: power, engineering

sense.en: Observations: relational thinking does not habitually meet power with fear, hostility and confrontation; Chinese engineering skill and pragmatic method come from relational thinking. The folder marks the last as unsourced with rival explanations, and in tension with listing pragmatism among the kernel's degenerations.

entries.quote: 这也是为什么中国人很擅长工程这样的问题

reading.en: Claims about cultures, untaken and out of the account's form, which argues about dynamics. 06 says the relational start is no property of every system, and 08 that no cultural origin validates a method. On power the account has a structural neighbour only: checks that carry acts back into what selects the rule. It says nothing of attitude. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The whole; kept as Ren's observations in the folder.

name.en: Thinking past oneself extends the horizon

source.locator: Own words 2-3; genealogy, 2026-03-14 'the observation that starts it'

sense.en: The observation that starts the folder: think about what comes after our children, the future world, the next generation, as if we are a part of the world, not just ourselves; thinking beyond yourself extends the horizon you can see at all. Ren's own, spoken of as a cultural difference.

entries.quote: as if we are a part of the world, not just ourselves

reading.en: Reach past one's own end has exact forms. Read with time, and where lines share no condition, self-concern without the step of invariance reaches only one's own line of descent. Under an organism's class nothing of the self follows its end; under a coarser one the line goes on through new members; which class a center's line runs under is open. The members a condition one affects later feeds are reached with no step; whether an actual commons is so is empirical. [AI reading]

says.en: Step 2: read with time and where lines share no condition, self-concern without the step reaches only one's own line of descent. Under P1 to P4 it reaches everything downstream of what one conditions, a law given the premises; P2 and P4 are the crux.

Reading [AI reading, new]: under an organism's class nothing of the self follows its end, under a coarser one the line can go on through new members; which class a center's own line runs under is what the represented dynamics leave open.

Reaches the members a condition one affects later feeds, with no step of invariance; which class a center's line runs under is open, and the one is not chosen; whether an actual commons is so is empirical.

account_adds.en: Which later members are reached, under which class, and that seeing further does not by itself change what is valued (seeing is not valuing).
